population.note: Headline cost uses fills on unmodified fork state from the product crank. P5 fills trade against a cheatcode-modified mint and P3 moves the clock, so both are left out; every executed slice still counts toward the verified rate.

allInCostPer100.definition: Per executed slice: USDC in (protocol fee included) against the reference value of the shares the owner kept (issuer transfer fee excluded from shares), per $100
allInCostPer100.provenance: LegExecuted decoded from each fill's getTransaction logs; guard-math buyPremiumBps

verifiedRate.provenance: Fork verifier: surfnet readback and Hermes history per slice

overpaymentAvoided.definition: (price at first attempt - executed price) x shares, for slices that waited and later filled

expiredAvoidedPremium.note: Reported separately; never counted as savings

manualStepsPerPayday.provenance: Signer flags in every stored transaction after setup

networkCost.note: Execute-transaction fees the crank pays; borne by the protocol, not in all-in cost

speed.reason: A fork has no network contention (PRD 23.9)

baselines.note: Computed at the product arm's first-attempt timestamps and amounts, not executed

script: per asset: choose, enter amount, review, sign
deposit the paycheck into the recurring order

cexLuno.source: Luno Nigeria published 2% per trade fee, as registered in PRD 23.2

guard.label: Arm D, replayed from the recorded first-attempt quotes, not executed

oracle.label: Jupiter's own quote as the only reference, replayed, not executed

chain.label: Computed, not executed: Ethereum mainnet gas at the same timestamps

runs.gasBasis: median gasUsed of all 9 recent transactions that moved NVDAx on Ethereum (0 carried a standard AMM swap event)

decisionRules.rule: Median all-in cost per $100 <= $0.50 passes; above $1.00 withdraws the claim
At least one slice waited and later filled in band with measured overpayment avoided
decisionRules.consequence: Describe the guard only as protection, with the live PreStocks premium as its evidence
